howItWorks.title: How AgriCare AI Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get clear, actionable guidance in four simple steps

step1.title: 1. Capture or Upload
step1.desc: Take a photo of the affected plant leaf or upload an image from your gallery.

step2.title: 2. AI Visual Diagnosis
step2.desc: Our vision engine analyzes lesions, discoloration, and patterns to detect anomalies.

step3.title: 3. Environmental Context
step3.desc: Cross-reference disease susceptibility with local temperature, humidity, and rainfall.

step4.title: 4. Actionable Advisory
step4.desc: Receive safe cultural practices, organic treatments, and clear prevention steps.

dashboard.noScans: No scans recorded yet. Capture your first crop leaf to assess its health!
quickTipsList: Water crops early morning to reduce evaporation and fungal leaf growth.
Check underside of leaves for early aphid and mite infestations.
Avoid spraying pesticides during high winds to minimize drift.

scan.title: AI Leaf Health Diagnostic
scan.subtitle: Point your camera or upload a clear photo of an affected leaf for diagnosis.
scan.dragDrop: Drag and drop leaf image here, or browse
scan.analyzingDesc: Checking leaf pigmentation, spot patterns, and cross-referencing agricultural models...
tips: Ensure good natural daylight without strong shadows or direct glare.
Focus closely on the symptomatic leaf portion showing discoloration or spots.
Keep camera steady and wipe lens for sharp image clarity.
Avoid blurry, distant, or multi-plant overlapping photos.

result.title: Diagnostic Report
result.disclaimer: AI-generated results provide preliminary guidance, not a certified laboratory diagnosis. Consult a local agricultural extension officer or certified agronomist for critical crop loss situations.
